meta.name: MiniMax H3 Reference Prompt Builder
notes: This file is both the seed data and the full build contract. A builder must run correctly against it with zero hardcoded group labels, option labels or clause text.
Uploading a replacement file must re-render the whole app from the new object. Only meta.storage_key stays fixed.
If a top-level key is absent, fall back to the embedded copy; if a group is absent, drop that group silently.
Typos must surface: parse with JSON.parse so malformed uploads throw a catchable runtime error instead of failing quietly.

output.format: six labelled fields, label on its own line, body below, one blank line between fields

references.orderRule: Picture order is always subjects first, then environment. Environment index = subject count + 1.

motion.label: <Video 1>
motion.demotion: motion and timing only, never subject, wardrobe or room

rules.{A}: solo: 'She'. Two subjects: 'The {nounA}'; if both roles are the same type, 'The first {nounA}'.
rules.{B}: two subjects only: 'the {nounB}'; if both roles are the same type, 'the second {nounB}'.

rules.{Bvul}: ' vulva' when role is woman, otherwise empty string

binding.text: This frame is already the target scene — do not re-imagine it.
<Picture 1> is exactly the first subject as supplied, unchanged.
<Picture 2> is exactly the second subject as supplied, unchanged.
<Picture {envIndex}> is exactly the room as supplied, unchanged.
<Video 1> is a motion reference only: copy its movement and timing, never its subject, its wardrobe or its room.

scaffold.watermark_clause: No watermark, no logo and no text overlay anywhere in the frame.
scaffold.anti_stiff_base: Nothing about the body is ever still. Breath moves the ribs, weight shifts, fingers flex and re-grip, the jaw slackens and tightens, she blinks, swallows and sways. No pose is held frozen for more than a moment.
scaffold.closing_permanence: Permanence: the subjects, the room and the light stay identical from the first frame to the last — nothing drifts, morphs or re-renders.
scaffold.avoid: AVOID: face morphing, identity drift, changing room or set dressing, warping hands and extra fingers, mannequin stiffness, the motion reference hijacking subject or room, watermarks and text overlays.
scaffold.priority_line: Priority: identity and environment always beat the motion reference.
scaffold.mirror_line: Both partners carry the same tells at the same beats.
scaffold.music_on: A low ambient music bed sits under everything — sparse, warm, unobtrusive, no melody hooks, no drops.
scaffold.music_off: No music. Room tone and body sound only.

subject_definitions.subjectLine: <Picture {index}> is the {ordinal} subject — {longDesc}. Identity, face, body, skin tone, hair and proportions are fully_preserved.
subject_definitions.environmentLine: <Picture {envIndex}> is the environment{settingClause}. Set dressing, surfaces, props, light direction and colour temperature are fully_preserved.

summary.template: A {duration}s reference-to-video clip: {bits}. {subjectCount} supplied subject picture{plural} plus one supplied environment picture lock the identity, the room and the light. {motionClause}
summary.motionClauseOn: The supplied motion video drives movement and timing only.
summary.motionClauseOff: Nothing outside the supplied frames is invented.
summary.durationRule: max seconds parsed from arc.beats when timecoded_beats is on, clamped 5-15, default 10

retention_analysis.subjectLine: <Picture {index}>: fully_preserved — {ordinal} subject identity, face, body, skin, hair, proportions.
retention_analysis.environmentLine: <Picture {envIndex}>: fully_preserved — environment, dressing, surfaces, props, light direction, colour temperature.
retention_analysis.motionLine: <Video 1>: weak_reference — movement, rhythm and timing only. It must never overwrite the subjects or the room.

overall_soundscape.override: pack.wet_handjob_audio replaces the entire field when selected
